## The two-way spanner table

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(apaTables)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
apa.2way.table(iv1 = gender, iv2 = alcohol, dv = attractiveness,
               data = goggles, show.marginal.means = TRUE) |>
  apa.quarto.revealjs()
```
